title: HR Manager
description:
We are a 120-person software services company in Lahore looking for an HR Manager to lead our people function.

Responsibilities:
- Own full-cycle recruitment for engineering and business roles; partner with department heads on workforce planning
- Manage onboarding, offboarding, attendance, leave and monthly payroll inputs
- Handle employee relations: grievances, disciplinary matters and performance improvement plans
- Run the annual performance management cycle and KPI frameworks
- Develop and maintain HR policies, SOPs and the employee handbook in line with Pakistani labour law
- Maintain HRIS data and produce monthly HR reports and dashboards

Requirements:
- 6+ years of HR experience, at least 2 in a managerial role
- Experience in IT/software or BPO/call center environments
- Strong knowledge of payroll, compensation and performance management
- Experience with an HRIS (Zoho People, BambooHR or similar)
- Excellent communication in English and Urdu
- Bachelor's degree; HR certification is a plus
